name: p32_public931_exact
title: Biohub P32 Public931 Exact
purpose: THE controlled experiment for the 2026-08-29 pivot: run the public configuration reported at 0.931 EXACTLY, unmodified, as one preregistered submission. It is run verbatim rather than reconstructed because the one genuine association-side difference from our champion is the bidirectional FUSION RULE - harmonic-probability at 0.15 against our plain linear blend at 0.20 - and no notebook in our tree implements harmonic_probability, so any reconstruction would be a re-derivation of the thing under test. FACT-0377 as corrected: the secondary low_margin_consensus is NOT a difference - the deployed P24 champion already runs it with identical parameters; the LOEO controls only appear to lack it because the harness cuts contaminated auxiliaries (FACT-0378). The remaining differences are solver (ILP disappearance 2.0, division 1.2), detector threshold 0.965, gap-2 recovery and adaptive short-track rescue on, safe-division radii, and the epoch-500 DeepCenter with its safe-division veto off. This CANNOT be judged offline: the secondary is trained on all 199 movies, legitimate against a hidden test set but un-measurable by any LOEO control we can build (FACT-0378). Submission is therefore the only instrument, which is why exactly one is preregistered. A positive result establishes that the lineage transfers to our deployment and gives a stronger baseline; it attributes nothing to any individual knob, all of which remain confounded.

provenance.author_credit: Configuration and harmonic-probability fusion implementation are the work of Kaggle user stephennedumpally, published publicly. Run here unmodified as a controlled replication; no authorship is claimed.
provenance.reported_score: 0.931 public LB, per host report - not independently reproduced by us
provenance.modifications: none - the notebook is run byte-identical to the pulled public version
provenance.why_verbatim: Reconstructing harmonic-probability fusion would re-derive the exact mechanism under test and risk a subtly different implementation being credited or blamed.
